info.title: Marketapp API
info.description:
**At the moment, this API is free but may be changed in the future.**

Follow the [Marketapp API](https://t.me/marketapp_api) channel for the latest news and updates.

## Authentication

Endpoints require authentication via API token.

**How to authenticate:**
0. Get your API token from the [Marketapp](https://marketapp.ws/api-token)
1. Add `Authorization` header to your request
2. Set the header value to your API token (without any prefix like "Bearer")

**Example:**
```
Authorization: your_api_token_here
```

## Code Examples

Some endpoints will return a transaction that you need to send to the blockchain yourself.
See [this example](https://github.com/crazyministr/marketapp-api-usage/blob/master/send_tx.py) to learn how to do this.

get.description: Get NFTs on sale by collection address

Return gifts on sale (onchain only).

**NOTE**: in current moment `cursor` works in such a way that each next page may contain elements of the previous one.

- **cursor**: Pagination cursor (optional)
- **collection_address**: Filter by specific collection address (optional)
- **model**: Filter by model (optional)
- **symbol**: Filter by symbol (optional)
- **backdrop**: Filter by backdrop (optional)
- **sort_by**: Sort order (optional, default: min_bid_asc)
- **item_num_from**: Filter by item number from (optional)
- **item_num_to**: Filter by item number to (optional)
- **min_price**: Filter by min price in TON (optional)
- **max_price**: Filter by max price in TON (optional)

Return gifts history (only sales at the moment).

- **cursor**: Pagination cursor (optional)
- **collection_address**: Filter by collection address (optional)
- **min_price**: Filter by min price in TON (optional)
- **max_price**: Filter by max price in TON (optional)
- **order_by**: Order by (optional, default: new_to_old)
- **limit**: Limit the number of items returned (optional, default: 10, max: 100)
